description: This file defines a Catalyst view class for rendering HTML pages using Template Toolkit in the Coocook application. It includes configuration, a method for escaping titles, and a proxy method for static URI generation.

classes.name: Coocook::View::HTML
classes.description: A Catalyst view class for rendering HTML pages with Template Toolkit, including configuration and helper methods.

methods.name: escape_title
methods.description: Sets the 'title' and 'html_title' in the stash with escaped content, using the HTML filter from the template context.

methods.name: uri_for_static
methods.description: Proxy method that delegates static URI generation to the Catalyst context.
